title: Jubilant Greek Shrimp Salad
description: A floral, creamy Greek shrimp salad featuring a quick blanch in cooking wine and a honey-rose water yogurt dressing.

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt, honey, rose water
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp yogurt, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp rose water

instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the shrimp and cook for 1 minute, then pour the cooking wine over them, letting it reduce for 1 minute while the shrimp blanch.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside to cool slightly.
In a large bowl, combine cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olives, and feta cheese.
Whisk the Greek yogurt, honey, rose water, and lemon juice until smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the vegetable mixture and toss gently to coat.
Add the blanched shrimp, fresh dill, and mint to the bowl.
Gently fold everything together, ensuring the shrimp are evenly distributed.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional lemon juice or salt if needed.
Serve the salad immediately, optionally garnished with extra dill or mint.
